name: Prestige Shantiniketan
description: A high-density luxury residential complex featuring a mix of high-rise towers and a large crescent-shaped block. The layout is centered around a large internal park and forest area with a perimeter road system and multiple pedestrian walkways. Security is managed via a walled perimeter with controlled access points. Imported from satellite + OpenStreetMap on 15/10/2026: 31 buildings, 79 roads/paths, 2 gates. AI-inferred items are marked as inferred.
